cards.en: What is a song you secretly love but would never play when other people are around?
cards.hi: Kaunsa song aapko chupke se bahut pasand hai, jise sabke saamne play karne mein sharam aati hai?

cards.en: What is the weirdest question you have ever asked a search engine or an AI chatbot?
cards.hi: Aapne Google ya kisi AI chatbot se ab tak ka sabse ajeeb sawaal kya poocha hai?

cards.en: Which of your habits drives your family a little crazy, and do you plan to stop?
cards.hi: Aapki kaunsi aadat ghar walon ko thoda pagal kar deti hai, aur kya use chhodne ka koi plan hai?

cards.en: What rule did you break at school or work that still makes you laugh, and did anyone find out?
cards.hi: School ya office ka kaunsa rule aapne toda tha jise yaad karke aaj bhi hansi aati hai? Kisi ko pata chala?

cards.en: What is something you pretended to understand, but actually had no idea about?
cards.hi: Aisi kaunsi cheez hai jise samajhne ka aapne natak kiya, par asal mein kuch pata hi nahi tha?

cards.en: What is the most dramatic reaction you have ever had to something very small?
cards.hi: Kisi chhoti si baat par aapka ab tak ka sabse dramatic reaction kya raha hai?

cards.en: Who here would you trust to plan a surprise for you, and who would accidentally spoil it?
cards.hi: Yahan surprise plan karne ke liye aapka bharosa kis par hai, aur kisse galti se surprise kharab ho sakta hai?

cards.en: What is the silliest thing you ever did to impress a crush?
cards.hi: Crush ko impress karne ke liye aapne sabse silly cheez kya ki hai?

cards.en: Have you ever had a crush on a cartoon or movie character? Who was it?
cards.hi: Kya aapko kabhi kisi cartoon ya movie character par crush hua hai? Kaunsa character tha?

cards.en: What is the strangest gift you have ever received, and what did you say when you opened it?
cards.hi: Aapko ab tak ka sabse ajeeb gift kya mila hai, aur use kholte hi aapne kya bola?

cards.en: If you came with a warning label like a product, what would it say?
cards.hi: Agar aap par kisi product ki tarah warning label lagta, toh us par kya likha hota?

cards.en: What is the most useless fact you still remember from school?
cards.hi: School ka sabse bekaar fact kaunsa hai jo aapko aaj bhi yaad hai?

cards.en: What is the most embarrassing story your family tells about you in front of guests?
cards.hi: Mehmaanon ke saamne aapki family aapke baare mein sabse embarrassing kahani kaunsi sunati hai?

cards.en: What is the funniest message you ever sent to the wrong person or group?
cards.hi: Aapne galti se galat insaan ya group mein sabse funny message kya bheja hai?

cards.en: What is a small lie you told that grew much bigger than you expected?
cards.hi: Aapka kaunsa chhota sa jhooth expect se kahin zyada bada ban gaya?

cards.en: What is the most awkward thing that happened to you on a video call or in an online class?
cards.hi: Video call ya online class mein aapke saath sabse awkward kya hua hai?

cards.en: What is the most awkward way you have ever tried to end a conversation?
cards.hi: Kisi baat-cheet ko khatam karne ke liye aapne sabse awkward tareeka kya try kiya hai?

cards.en: If your phone could talk, what would it complain about most?
cards.hi: Agar aapka phone bol pata, toh woh aapki kis baat ki sabse zyada shikayat karta?

cards.en: What is something silly you get secretly competitive about?
cards.hi: Kaunsi silly cheez hai jismein aapka competitive side chupke se bahar aa jaata hai?

cards.en: Which movie villain do you think was a little bit right?
cards.hi: Aapke hisaab se kaunsa movie villain thoda sa sahi tha?

cards.en: Rate your cooking from 1 to 10, then tell us about your biggest kitchen disaster.
cards.hi: Apni cooking ko 1 se 10 tak rating dijiye, phir apna sabse bada kitchen disaster bataiye.

cards.en: What very popular food, movie or song do you not like at all?
cards.hi: Kaunsa bahut popular khana, movie ya song aapko bilkul pasand nahi hai?

cards.en: If one person here had to do your homework or job for a month, who would you choose and why?
cards.hi: Agar yahan kisi ek ko ek mahine tak aapka homework ya kaam karna pade, toh aapki choice kaun hai aur kyun?

cards.en: Pick a player here. What did you first think of them, and were you right? Keep it kind.
cards.hi: Yahan ek player chuniye. Unke baare mein aapne pehle kya socha tha, aur kya woh sahi nikla? Pyaar se boliye.

cards.en: What small thing can a person do that makes you like them instantly?
cards.hi: Koi insaan kaunsi chhoti si cheez kare toh woh aapko turant pasand aa jaata hai?

cards.en: Check the last emoji you sent. Act like it for 20 seconds while everyone guesses which emoji it is.
cards.hi: Apna last bheja hua emoji dekhiye. 20 seconds tak use act karke dikhaiye, jab tak baaki sab guess karein ki kaunsa emoji hai.

cards.en: Invent a useless product and sell it to us for 30 seconds, like a loud TV advertisement.
cards.hi: Ek bekaar sa product sochiye aur 30 seconds tak loud TV ad ki tarah use humein bechiye.

cards.en: Act like a strict teacher who has just discovered that the whole class forgot their homework.
cards.hi: Aise strict teacher ki acting kariye jinhe abhi pata chala hai ki poori class homework bhool gayi hai.

cards.en: Describe your morning routine in the voice of a dramatic movie villain.
cards.hi: Apni morning routine ek dramatic movie villain ki awaaz mein bataiye.

cards.en: Sing "Happy Birthday" as if it is the saddest song in the world.
cards.hi: "Happy Birthday" aise gaiye jaise yeh duniya ka sabse dukhi gaana ho.

cards.en: Be a music conductor: the group hums a song you choose, and your hands make them louder or softer.
cards.hi: Music conductor baniye: group aapka chuna hua gaana gungunayega, aur aapke haathon ke ishaare par awaaz tez ya dheemi hogi.

cards.en: Name an object in this room for each letter of your first name, in 20 seconds.
cards.hi: 20 seconds mein apne first name ke har letter se is room ki ek cheez ka naam boliye.

cards.en: For 30 seconds, give the group silly, safe commands. They follow only commands that start with "Captain says".
cards.hi: 30 seconds tak group ko silly aur safe commands dijiye. Sab sirf wahi command maanein jo "Captain says" se shuru ho.

cards.en: Lead everyone in a slow-motion celebration, as if you all just won the World Cup.
cards.hi: Sabse slow-motion mein aisa celebration karwaiye jaise aap sabne abhi World Cup jeeta ho.

cards.en: Invent a new dance move, give it a funny name, and teach it to everyone.
cards.hi: Ek naya dance move banaiye, uska funny naam rakhiye, aur sabko sikhaiye.

cards.en: Count slowly from 1 to 20 while the other players try to make you laugh without touching you.
cards.hi: 1 se 20 tak dheere dheere ginti kariye, jab tak baaki players bina chhue aapko hansane ki koshish karein.

cards.en: For 60 seconds, you can only speak in questions, while the other players try to trick you into normal answers.
cards.hi: 60 seconds tak sirf sawaalon mein baat kariye, jabki baaki players aapse normal jawab nikalwane ki koshish karein.

cards.en: With your eyes closed, guess who is speaking as the other players take turns saying "hello" in fake voices.
cards.hi: Aankhen band karke pehchaniye kiski awaaz hai, jab baaki players baari baari nakli awaaz mein "hello" bolein.

cards.en: Speak like a phone map app and give step-by-step directions from your seat to the door.
cards.hi: Phone ke map app ki tarah boliye aur apni seat se darwaze tak step-by-step raasta bataiye.

cards.en: Create a short rap or song about a player of your choice, using only kind words.
cards.hi: Apni pasand ke kisi player par ek chhota rap ya gaana banaiye, sirf achhi baatein use karke.

cards.en: Give every player a kind compliment, but shout it as if you are very angry.
cards.hi: Har player ko ek pyaara sa compliment dijiye, par aise chillakar jaise aapko bahut gussa aaya ho.

cards.en: Act like a phone with 1% battery, talking slower and slower until you switch off.
cards.hi: 1% battery wale phone ki tarah act kariye: aur dheere, aur dheere boliye, jab tak switch off na ho jaaye.

cards.en: Open an imaginary parcel twice: once it is your dream gift, once it is something totally wrong.
cards.hi: Ek imaginary parcel do baar kholiye: ek baar usmein aapka dream gift ho, ek baar kuch bilkul galat.

cards.en: In a friendly way, copy a phrase another player often says. Everyone else guesses who it is.
cards.hi: Pyaar se kisi player ki aisi line copy kariye jo unse aksar sunne ko milti hai. Baaki sab guess karein woh kaun hai.

cards.en: Say "banana" five times, each with a different feeling: happy, angry, scared, sleepy and shocked.
cards.hi: "Banana" paanch baar boliye, har baar alag feeling ke saath: khushi, gussa, darr, neend aur shock.

cards.en: Act out sneaking into the kitchen at midnight without waking anyone, then accidentally knocking over a steel plate.
cards.hi: Aadhi raat ko chupke se, bina kisi ko jagaye, kitchen mein jaane ki acting kariye; phir act kariye ki galti se steel ki plate gir gayi.

cards.en: Act out an argument between your left hand and right hand, using two different voices.
cards.hi: Apne left haath aur right haath ke beech ek bahas act kariye, do alag awaazon mein.

cards.en: Use any object as a microphone and interview another player as if they just came back from Mars.
cards.hi: Kisi bhi cheez ko mic banaiye aur ek player ka aise interview lijiye jaise unki abhi Mars se wapsi hui ho.

cards.en: Balance a cushion on your head and walk to the door and back without dropping it.
cards.hi: Sir par cushion rakhkar darwaze tak jaaiye aur wapas aaiye, bina cushion giraye.

cards.en: Give the bottle a name, then tell its life story dramatically in 20 seconds.
cards.hi: Bottle ka ek naam rakhiye, phir 20 seconds mein uski poori life story drama ke saath sunaiye.

cards.en: Would you rather fly, but only as high as your knees, or be invisible, but only when nobody is looking?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: udna, par sirf ghutno jitni oonchai tak, ya invisible hona, par sirf tab jab koi dekh na raha ho?

cards.en: Would you rather have your own theme song play whenever you enter a room, or hear clapping whenever you sit down?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: room mein aate hi apna theme song bajna, ya baithte hi taaliyan sunai dena?

cards.en: Would you rather eat the same meal every day, or never be allowed to eat the same meal twice?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: roz ek hi khana khana, ya ek khana kabhi dobara na kha paana?

cards.en: Would you rather sneeze every time you tell a lie, or laugh every time someone lies to you?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: har jhooth bolne par chheenk aana, ya koi aapse jhooth bole toh hansi chhoot jaana?

cards.en: Would you rather know the ending of every movie before watching it, or always fall asleep 10 minutes before the end?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: har movie ka end pehle se pata hona, ya hamesha end se 10 minute pehle neend aa jaana?

cards.en: Would you rather have your crush see your worst dance moves, or hear your worst singing?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: crush aapke sabse bure dance moves dekhe, ya aapki sabse buri singing sune?

cards.en: Would you rather be in a group chat with every teacher you ever had, or with every relative you have?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: apne saare teachers wala group chat, ya saare rishtedaaron wala group chat?

cards.en: Would you rather have a pet that talks but only complains, or one that sings loudly every night at 3 a.m.?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: aisa pet jo bolta hai par sirf shikayat karta hai, ya jo roz raat 3 baje zor se gaata hai?

cards.en: Never have I ever typed a long message to someone I liked, then deleted it without sending.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi kisi pasand wale insaan ke liye lamba message type karke, bina bheje delete nahi kiya.

cards.en: Never have I ever said "I'm on my way" while still lying in bed.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi bistar mein lete-lete "bas raaste mein hoon" nahi bola.

cards.en: Never have I ever kept walking the wrong way just so I would not look lost.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi sirf lost na dikhne ke liye galat raaste par chalna jaari nahi rakha.

cards.en: Never have I ever laughed so hard in class or at work that I had to leave the room.
cards.hi: Mujhe kabhi class ya office mein itni hansi nahi aayi ki room se bahar jaana pada.

cards.en: Never have I ever thought of the perfect reply to an argument hours after it ended.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi bahas khatam hone ke ghanton baad uska perfect jawab nahi socha.

cards.en: Never have I ever finished someone's snack and pretended I did not know where it went.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi kisi ka snack khatam karke aisa natak nahi kiya ki mujhe kuch pata hi nahi.

cards.en: Never have I ever cheated at a board game or card game just to win.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi sirf jeetne ke liye board game ya cards mein cheating nahi ki.

cards.en: Never have I ever cried at a movie and blamed it on something in my eye.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi movie par rone ke baad "aankh mein kuch chala gaya" wala bahana nahi banaya.

cards.en: Who is most likely to become famous for something completely random?
cards.hi: Kiske kisi bilkul random cheez ke liye famous hone ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to reply to a message three days late with just "haha"?
cards.hi: Kiske teen din baad message ka reply sirf "haha" mein karne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to argue with an AI chatbot and lose?
cards.hi: Kiske AI chatbot se bahas karke haarne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to make a new best friend while waiting in a line?
cards.hi: Kiske line mein wait karte-karte naya best friend banane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to know every shopkeeper in the neighbourhood by name?
cards.hi: Kiske mohalle ke har dukaandaar ko naam se jaanne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to plan a perfect trip and then forget the tickets?
cards.hi: Kiske perfect trip plan karke tickets bhool jaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to have a house full of rescued animals one day?
cards.hi: Kiske ghar ke ek din rescued janwaron se bhar jaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to go to a wedding as a guest and leave as part of the family?
cards.hi: Kiske shaadi mein guest bankar jaane aur family ka hissa bankar lautne ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: What is the weirdest nickname you have ever had, and how did you get it?
cards.hi: Aapka ab tak ka sabse ajeeb nickname kya raha hai, aur woh kaise pada?

cards.en: What is the longest you have stayed in the same pyjamas, and what was your excuse?
cards.hi: Aapne sabse zyada kitne din ek hi pyjama pehne rakha hai, aur bahana kya tha?

cards.en: What is the strangest thing inside your bag right now? You can show it or just tell us.
cards.hi: Abhi aapke bag mein sabse ajeeb cheez kya hai? Dikhaiye, ya bas bata dijiye.

cards.en: Which song title best describes your week so far, and why?
cards.hi: Kaunse song ka title aapke is hafte ko sabse achhe se describe karta hai, aur kyun?

cards.en: What is the most movie-like moment you have ever had in real life?
cards.hi: Real life mein aapka sabse filmy moment kaunsa raha hai?

cards.en: What is the most useless thing you did the night before a big exam?
cards.hi: Bade exam se pehle wali raat aapne sabse bekaar kaam kya kiya hai?

cards.en: If your life were a sitcom with a laugh track, which moment from this month would get the biggest laugh?
cards.hi: Agar aapki life ek sitcom hoti, toh is mahine ke kis moment par sabse zor ka laugh track bajta?

cards.en: What is the most dramatic thing you have done to get the window seat in a car, bus or train?
cards.hi: Car, bus ya train mein window seat paane ke liye aapne sabse dramatic kaam kya kiya hai?

cards.en: What is the strangest food combination you secretly enjoy?
cards.hi: Kaunsa ajeeb food combination aapko chupke se bahut pasand hai?

cards.en: What is the most childish thing you still secretly enjoy doing?
cards.hi: Aisi kaunsi bachkani cheez hai jo aaj bhi aapko chupke se karna pasand hai?

cards.en: If you were stuck in a lift for two hours, which player here would you want with you, and why?
cards.hi: Agar do ghante lift mein phasna pade, toh yahan se kaunsa player aapko saath chahiye, aur kyun?

cards.en: What is the most embarrassing way you have tripped or fallen in front of people?
cards.hi: Logon ke saamne girne ya phisalne ka aapka sabse embarrassing moment kaunsa hai?

cards.en: Have you ever put your hand up in class and then forgotten your answer? What did you say?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi class mein haath uthane ke baad aapko jawab hi yaad nahi raha? Phir aapne kya bola?

cards.en: What did you do as a kid that you thought was very clever, but really was not?
cards.hi: Bachpan mein aapne kya kiya tha jo tab bahut smart laga, par asal mein bilkul smart nahi tha?

cards.en: Have you ever forgotten someone's name while talking to them? How did you hide it?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi baat karte-karte aapko kisi ka naam yaad nahi aaya? Aapne yeh baat kaise chhupayi?

cards.en: What is a word you still spell wrong almost every time?
cards.hi: Kaunsa word aaj bhi aapse lagbhag har baar galat spell hota hai?

cards.en: Have you ever replied 'You too' when it made no sense, like after 'Enjoy your meal'?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi bina soche 'You too' bola hai, jaise kisi ke 'Enjoy your meal' kehne par?

cards.en: What is your favourite excuse for being late, and how often do you use it?
cards.hi: Late hone par aapka favourite bahana kya hai, aur woh kitni baar use hota hai?

cards.en: Which festival sweet or treat could you finish a whole box of by yourself?
cards.hi: Kaunsi festival wali mithai ya treat ka poora dibba akele khatam karna aapke liye bilkul easy hai?

cards.en: What is your most embarrassing moment while playing a sport, like cricket or football?
cards.hi: Cricket, football ya koi bhi sport khelte hue aapka sabse embarrassing moment kya raha hai?

cards.en: Which song would you pick for a group dance at a wedding or sangeet, and who here should dance in front?
cards.hi: Shaadi ya sangeet ke group dance ke liye aapka song kaunsa hoga, aur yahan se front row mein kise hona chahiye?

cards.en: Which snack would you never share, even with your best friend?
cards.hi: Kaunsa snack hai jo best friend ke saath bhi share karna aapko manzoor nahi?

cards.en: If you could delete one app from everyone's phone forever, which one would you pick?
cards.hi: Agar sabke phone se ek app hamesha ke liye delete karni ho, toh aapki choice kaunsi app hogi?

cards.en: What is the most embarrassing thing you have done while half asleep?
cards.hi: Aadhi neend mein aapne sabse embarrassing kaam kya kiya hai?

cards.en: What small, everyday thing are you secretly scared of, like lizards, balloons or dark stairs?
cards.hi: Kis chhoti, roz ki cheez se aapko chupke se darr lagta hai, jaise chhipkali, balloon ya andheri seedhiyan?

cards.en: If you could cancel one school or office rule forever, which one would it be?
cards.hi: Agar school ya office ka ek rule hamesha ke liye cancel karna ho, toh woh kaunsa hoga?

cards.en: Have you ever said goodbye to someone and then walked off in the same direction? What happened?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi aapko kisi ko bye bolne ke baad unhi ke saath same direction mein chalna pada? Phir kya hua?

cards.en: What is a kind thing someone said to you years ago that you still remember?
cards.hi: Saalon pehle kisi ne aapse kaunsi achhi baat kahi thi jo aaj bhi yaad hai?

cards.en: Have you ever been caught talking to yourself in public? What were you saying?
cards.hi: Kya kabhi kisi ne aapko public mein khud se baatein karte hue pakda hai? Kya baat chal rahi thi?

cards.en: What is the strangest thing you have done just because you were bored?
cards.hi: Sirf bore hone ki wajah se aapne sabse ajeeb kaam kya kiya hai?

cards.en: What was your most embarrassing moment on stage, like at a school function or annual day?
cards.hi: Stage par, jaise school function ya annual day mein, aapka sabse embarrassing moment kya tha?

cards.en: If you were a cup of chai or coffee, would you be strong, sweet, too hot or a bit cold? Why?
cards.hi: Agar aapko chai ya coffee ka cup banna pade, toh kaisa cup hoga: strong, meetha, bahut garam ya thoda thanda? Kyun?

cards.en: What is the most random skill you have learnt from an online video?
cards.hi: Kisi online video se aapne ab tak ki sabse random skill kya seekhi hai?

cards.en: Have you ever got on the wrong bus, train or metro? How far did it take you?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi galat bus, train ya metro pakdi hai? Pata chalne tak woh aapko kitni door le gayi?

cards.en: What is the strangest thing you have ever collected, and do you still have it?
cards.hi: Aapne ab tak sabse ajeeb cheez kya collect ki hai, aur kya woh abhi bhi aapke paas hai?

cards.en: Have you ever had a crush on someone mainly because of their voice or handwriting?
cards.hi: Kya aapko kabhi kisi par sirf unki awaaz ya handwriting ki wajah se crush hua hai?

cards.en: If your crush sat right next to you in class, would your marks go up or down? Why?
cards.hi: Agar crush class mein bilkul aapke bagal mein baithe, toh aapke marks badhenge ya girenge? Kyun?

cards.en: What is the funniest way you have tried to find out if your crush liked you back?
cards.hi: Kya crush ko bhi aap pasand hain, yeh jaanne ke liye aapne sabse funny tareeka kya try kiya hai?

cards.en: Which film song starts playing in your head when you see your crush? No names, please.
cards.hi: Crush ko dekhte hi aapke dimaag mein kaunsa film song bajne lagta hai? Naam mat lijiye.

cards.en: Have you ever found out someone had a crush on you long after everyone else knew?
cards.hi: Kya aapko kabhi pata chala ki kisi ka aap par crush tha, woh bhi sabko pata chalne ke kaafi baad?

cards.en: On a scale of 1 to 10, how obvious are you when you have a crush? The group can disagree.
cards.hi: 1 se 10 mein, crush hone par aapki feelings kitni obvious ho jaati hain? Group disagree kar sakta hai.

cards.en: Have you ever had a crush on someone you have never actually spoken to?
cards.hi: Kya aapko kabhi aise insaan par crush hua hai jisse aapne kabhi baat tak nahi ki?

cards.en: Have you ever told a friend about your crush and regretted it the next day?
cards.hi: Kya aapne kabhi kisi dost ko apne crush ke baare mein bataya aur agle din pachhtawa hua?

cards.en: Without using words, show us how you walk out of an exam you did not study for.
cards.hi: Bina bole act karke dikhaiye ki bina padhe exam dene ke baad hall se bahar kaise nikla jaata hai.

cards.en: Act out one ball of a cricket match alone: be the bowler, the batter, the umpire and the crowd.
cards.hi: Akele cricket ki ek ball act kariye: bowler, batter, umpire aur crowd, sab aap hi baniye.

cards.en: Sing one line of any famous song like a rapper, then sing it again like a very sleepy lullaby.
cards.hi: Kisi famous song ki ek line rapper ki tarah gaiye, phir wahi line neend bhari lori ki tarah gaiye.

cards.en: Be a busy chai seller on a train and sell an imaginary cup of chai to every player.
cards.hi: Train mein chai bechne ki acting kariye aur har player ko ek imaginary cup chai bechiye.

cards.en: Give a 30-second speech as the chief guest at a school's yearly prize-giving function.
cards.hi: School ke yearly prize function mein chief guest ban kar 30 seconds ki speech dijiye.

cards.en: Act like a wedding photographer and, using only words, arrange everyone into a dramatic pretend group photo.
cards.hi: Wedding photographer ki tarah act kariye aur sirf bol kar sabko ek dramatic nakli group photo ke liye pose karwaiye.

cards.en: Act like a ceiling fan on full speed that slowly stops when the power goes off.
cards.hi: Full speed par chalte ceiling fan ki acting kariye, jo light jaate hi dheere dheere ruk jaata hai.

cards.en: Explain to an alien who has never seen shoes how to tie a shoelace.
cards.hi: Ek alien ko shoelace baandhna samjhaiye, jisne kabhi joote dekhe hi nahi.

cards.en: Start passing an invisible hot samosa around the group. When you shout 'Stop!', whoever has it does a silly dance.
cards.hi: Group mein ek invisible garam samosa pass karwaiye. Aap 'Stop!' boliye, toh jiske haath mein ho, woh silly dance kare.

cards.en: Act out brushing your teeth as a dinosaur with very tiny arms.
cards.hi: Bahut chhote haathon wale dinosaur ki tarah brush karne ki acting kariye.

cards.en: Spell your full name backwards out loud in 15 seconds, without writing it down.
cards.hi: 15 seconds mein apna poora naam ulta spell kariye, bina likhe.

cards.en: Tell a 30-second horror story in which the scary monster is a lost TV remote.
cards.hi: 30 seconds ki ek horror story sunaiye jismein darawna monster ek khoya hua TV remote ho.

cards.en: Using a book as a laptop, act like someone in an online meeting who does not know they are muted.
cards.hi: Kitaab ko laptop banaiye aur online meeting mein aise insaan ki acting kariye jise pata hi nahi ki woh mute par hai.

cards.en: In 30 seconds, name five movies or songs that have a number in their title.
cards.hi: 30 seconds mein aisi paanch movies ya songs ke naam boliye jinke title mein koi number ho.

cards.en: Choose a player and plan their dream birthday party out loud in 30 seconds. They may reply only with faces.
cards.hi: Ek player chuniye aur 30 seconds mein bol kar unki dream birthday party plan kariye. Unhe sirf expressions se jawab dena hai.

cards.en: Give the group a loud, fiery team talk, as if we are losing a big final at half-time.
cards.hi: Group ko ek zordaar team talk dijiye, jaise half-time par hum ek bada final haar rahe hon.

cards.en: Take attendance like a teacher, giving each player a new, kind nickname. Each answers 'Present!' in a funny voice.
cards.hi: Teacher ki tarah attendance lijiye aur har player ko ek naya, pyaara nickname dijiye. Sab funny awaaz mein 'Present!' bolein.

cards.en: Using a cushion as a phone, act out a 20-second call where you hear you have won a trip to the moon.
cards.hi: Cushion ko phone banaiye aur 20 seconds ki aisi call act kariye jismein pata chale ki aapne chaand ki trip jeeti hai.

cards.en: Be a railway station announcer and, in a loud echo voice, announce that this game is running very late.
cards.hi: Railway station announcer baniye aur goonjti awaaz mein announce kariye ki yeh game bahut late chal raha hai.

cards.en: Act out making a perfectly round roti, then react when it comes out shaped like a star.
cards.hi: Ekdum gol roti banane ki acting kariye, phir react kariye jab woh star ke shape mein ban jaaye.

cards.en: Describe your favourite food for 20 seconds without saying its name. The group guesses what it is.
cards.hi: 20 seconds tak apne favourite khane ke baare mein boliye, bina uska naam liye. Group guess kare kya hai.

cards.en: Walk across the room as if the floor is very hot sand at the beach.
cards.hi: Room mein aise chaliye jaise zameen beach ki bahut garam ret ho.

cards.en: Act out trying to open a packet of chips that just will not tear, getting more dramatic every second.
cards.hi: Aise act kariye jaise chips ka packet khul hi nahi raha, aur har second ke saath aapka drama badhta ja raha hai.

cards.en: Be a very strict security guard and check every player's imaginary ID card before they can keep playing.
cards.hi: Ek bahut strict security guard ka role kariye aur khel aage badhne se pehle har player ka imaginary ID card check kariye.

cards.en: Lead everyone in a 15-second drum roll on their laps, then announce something very boring, like today's date.
cards.hi: Sabse apni godi par 15 seconds ka drum roll karwaiye, phir koi bahut boring baat announce kariye, jaise aaj ki date.

cards.en: For 30 seconds, chat with a player of your choice using only famous movie dialogues.
cards.hi: Apni pasand ke ek player se 30 seconds tak sirf famous film dialogues mein baat kariye.

cards.en: Act out how you would walk past your crush in a corridor, trying very hard to look cool.
cards.hi: Corridor mein crush ke saamne se cool dikhne ki poori koshish karte hue walk karke dikhaiye.

cards.en: Would you rather sit your toughest exam again tomorrow, or give a five-minute speech at morning assembly?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: kal phir se apna sabse tough exam dena, ya morning assembly mein paanch minute ki speech dena?

cards.en: Would you rather have a phone that types only in capitals, or one that adds a random emoji to every message?
cards.hi: Aapko kya pasand hai: aisa phone jo sirf capital letters mein type kare, ya jo har message mein random emoji jod de?

cards.en: Never have I ever clapped at the wrong moment, like in the middle of a song or speech.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi galat time par taali nahi bajayi, jaise kisi song ya speech ke beech mein.

cards.en: Never have I ever said hi to my crush and then replayed it in my head all night.
cards.hi: Maine kabhi crush ko 'hi' bolne ke baad poori raat woh moment dimaag mein replay nahi kiya.

cards.en: Who is most likely to fall asleep first at a sleepover?
cards.hi: Kiske sleepover mein sabse pehle so jaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?

cards.en: Who is most likely to become the admin of every group chat they join?
cards.hi: Kiske har group chat ka admin ban jaane ke chances sabse zyada hain?
